Dive into Fisch, the ultimate fishing adventure where exploration and progression are yours to control. Cast your line to catch rare and unique fish, each with 400,000+ possible variations. Explore a growing world with your trusty rod, and maybe even reel in some new friends along the way!

• When the progress bar on the bottom is full, you'll reel in your catch!

data.name: ⛏️ My Anime Mine
data.description:
My Anime Mine is a unique incremental game. Multiply your crew's damage by leveling them up, mutating them and enchanting them!

⛏️ Your Anime Characters break rocks for ores
💪 Level Up your crew's damage
🎲 Roll OP Enchantments
🪄 Summon Limited Characters
⌛ Upgrade the Research Tree to unlock the next mining zone!

🔁 Player Trading unlocks in the last zone!

data.name: +1 Speed Keyboard Escape | Candy & Chocolate

data.name: [🔥NEW MYTHIC] Hypershot
data.description:
✨Welcome to Hypershot!✨
Jump into our intense and fast paced first person gunfight shooter where skill, style, and chaos rule supreme! 

🏆Dominate in intense classic gamemodes such as Team Deathmatch, Capture the Flag, Free for All, and Gun Game (Arsenal).
💥Team up with friends to challenge rivals to 1v1 or 2v2 duels
👑Climb the ranks to reach the leaderboard!
🌀Master your abilities to outmaneuver and outplay your enemies!
🔥Earn coins and gems to unlock new weapons, skins, abilities, and so much more!
🎮Available on PC, phones, tablets, and console

❤️Made with love by Frosted Studios
